u,c=np.unique(im.reshape(-1,3),axis=0,return_counts=True)
print('target dominant')
for ix in np.argsort(c)[-30:][::-1]: print(tuple(u[ix]),int(c[ix]))
sc=np.array(Image.open('/app/output/view_scene_cam.png').convert('RGB'))
d=np.load('/app/output/depth_scene_cam.npy')
# find visible blobs of colors nearest palette at camera
for i,col in enumerate(cs):
 dist=np.linalg.norm(sc.astype(float)-col,axis=2)
 mask=(dist<40)&(d>0)
 labels,n=ndimage.label(mask)
 objs=ndimage.find_objects(labels)
 cand=[]
 for j,sl in enumerate(objs,1):
  if sl is None:continue
  area=(labels[sl]==j).sum()
  if area>=4:
   ys,xs=sl; pix=np.argwhere(labels[sl]==j); yy=pix[:,0]+ys.start;xx=pix[:,1]+xs.start
   cand.append((area,xx.mean(),yy.mean(),float(np.median(d[yy,xx])),np.median(sc[yy,xx],axis=0).astype(int)))
 print('palette',i+1, sorted(cand,reverse=True)[:6])

+                # Per the service contract, a failed in-flight call is lost as
+                # a whole.  Wait for replay, then resend this exact chunk.
+                print(f"submit connection/error; waiting to resume: {exc}", flush=True)
+                ready = robot.wait_ready()
+                print("service ready:", ready, flush=True)
+        if res.meta.get("stopped") or int(res.meta.get("executed_rows", -1)) != len(actions):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"incomplete action chunk: executed={res.meta.get('executed_rows')} "
+                f"of {len(actions)}, stopped={res.meta.get('stopped')}"
+            )
+        now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=np.float64)
+        cur = now.copy()
+        cur[3:7] = ORI_DOWN
+        calls_done += 1
+        state = {
+            "next_stroke": int(checkpoint),
+            "completed_strokes": int(checkpoint),
+            "last_color": (plan[checkpoint - 1]["color"] + 1) if checkpoint else None,
+            "service_status": robot.status(),
+        }
+        atomic_json(STATE, state)
+        append_progress(
+            {
+                "chunk": calls_done,
+                "next_stroke": checkpoint,
+                "total_strokes": total,
+                "rows": len(actions),
+                "control_steps": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+                "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                "status": state["service_status"],
+            }
+        )
+        print(
+            f"chunk {calls_done}: strokes through {checkpoint}/{total}; "
+            f"{len(actions)} rows, status {state['service_status']}",
+            flush=True,
+        )
+        buf = []
+        buffer_next_stroke = checkpoint
+
+    def add_dip(color: int) -> None:
+        wx, wy = WELLS[color]
+        add_pose(np.asarray([wx, wy, Z_WELL_CLEAR, *ORI_DOWN]))
+        add_pose(np.asarray([wx, wy, Z_DIP, *ORI_DOWN]))
+        add_hold(5)  # 0.25 s below the paint surface
+        add_pose(np.asarray([wx, wy, Z_WELL_CLEAR, *ORI_DOWN]))
+        add_hold(2)
+
+    def add_stroke(stroke: dict) -> None:
+        nonlocal cur
+        z = float(stroke["z"])
+        first = target_pose(stroke, stroke["u0"], Z_CLEAR)
+        last = target_pose(stroke, stroke["u1"], Z_CLEAR)
+        # Travel above the sheet, then descend at the first point.  Keep a
+        # short contact settle so the tuft reaches the planned pressure.
+        add_pose(first)
+        contact_start = first.copy()
+        contact_start[2] = z
+        add_pose(contact_start)
+        add_hold(2)
+
+        contact_end = target_pose(stroke, stroke["u1"], z)
+        distance = float(np.linalg.norm(contact_end[:3] - contact_start[:3]))
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / 0.005)))
+        for p in np.linspace(contact_start, contact_end, n + 1)[1:]:
+            add_pose(p)
+
+        raised = contact_end.copy()
+        raised[2] = Z_CLEAR
+        add_pose(raised)
+        add_hold(2)

+    through = args.through_color - 1
+    while i < total and plan[i]["color"] <= through:
+        color = plan[i]["color"]
+        group_end = i
+        while group_end < total and plan[group_end]["color"] == color:
+            group_end += 1
+        group_end = min(group_end, total)
+        add_dip(color)

+        if buf:

+        try:
+            frame = robot.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam"]).last["canvas_cam"]
+            Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"progress_paint{color + 1:02d}.png")
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("could not save progress frame:", exc, flush=True)
+        if robot.status().get("done"):
+            print("episode ended:", robot.status(), flush=True)
